title: Support
needHelpBody: If you're running into an issue with FaceUp — a bug, a question about your account, or anything else — reach out and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
accountBody: You can change your username or password, or permanently delete your account, from Profile → Settings inside the app.
purchasesBodyPrefix: Purchases are processed through the app store you downloaded FaceUp from. For refund requests, contact that store's support directly — see our
